newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 70 OF MARCH 12, 1997.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 70 OF MARCH 12, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

COMMISSION DECISION of 20 February 1997 amending Decision 94/652/EC establishing the inventory and distribution of tasks to be undertaken within the framework of cooperation by Member States in the scientific examination of questions relating to food (Text with EEA relevance) (97/174/EC)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 466/97 of 11 March 1997 on the issuing of A1 export licences for fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 465/97 of 11 March 1997 determining the world market price for unginned cotton and the rate for the aid
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 464/97 of 11 March 1997 amending representative prices and additional duties for the import of certain products in the sugar sector
